location_exception_reason: PVC Guard Huts are manufactured prefabricated units with standardised specifications and performance ratings (wind resistance, thermal insulation, assembly method). Location of manufacture or deployment does not alter the product's functional attributes or buyer decision logic — a 4×4 ft PVC guard hut from Delhi performs identically to one from Chennai. Buyer selection is driven by size, material composition, customisation options, and price, not origin geography.
biz_exception_reason: IndiaMART's seller-type filter (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer, Distributor, etc.) already exposes business relationship independently of product titles. Removing 'Manufacturer' or 'Supplier' from a PVC Guard Hut title leaves the product complete and unambiguous — the hut itself is the product, not the business arrangement. Business-type words in titles are redundant.
